column5: F: Why we follow iDempiere exactly. | M: Same model. Same screens. The extras sit beside it.

column3: chapter card 1: a proven data model
column5: F: A proven data model. Every window, field, process and document in iDempiere is a row in one application dictionary. | M: That dictionary is proven. So we do not invent another one. We follow it, row for row.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT card.dictionary census: legacy | twin counts read live
column5: M: We counted the dictionary in real iDempiere and in the twin. | F: Tables, columns, fields, processes and menu entries: identical, to the row. | M: Only windows differ: three more in the twin than in iDempiere. That one is on our list to close.
F: Same look and feel, verbatim. The menu, the windows, the tabs, the grid and form, the toolbar. | M: So there is nothing to learn. Whoever knows iDempiere already knows this.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT live: menu, Sales Order, icon toolbar; witness_toolbar_icons T1-T4
column5: M: The menu is iDempiere's menu. We open the Sales Order window. | F: The toolbar is iDempiere's: icons only, in its order, with its tooltips. We checked twenty five windows against iDempiere's own rows and source, and all agree. | M: Find opens iDempiere's own lookup window. The grid and form toggle, and the more menu with its fourteen further tools, are where iDempiere puts them.

column3: chapter card 3: extras in plugins and pills
column4: F: The extras stay beside it.
column5: F: Everything we add stays out of iDempiere's screens. | M: Extras live in the pill tray, and bigger modules arrive as plugins.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT live: pill tray (17 pills), Plugin Engine offer (2 bundles)
column5: M: Here is the tray. Seventeen pills: reports, point of sale, kitchen, warehouse walk, Excel report, and the plugin engine. | F: The engine holds two plugin bundles and offers to install them. A bundle brings its own windows and processes, without touching the core.
M: Same dictionary, same screens, same habits. Learn iDempiere once, and you already know this. | F: Following it exactly keeps your right to use it, and the extras never get in the way.
